THE NARRATIVE

YOU ARE
LUCAS.

A picnic date turns violent when your girlfriend Janaye confronts you — then armed strangers take everything. Bound in an abandoned warehouse, every second counts. Every choice echoes.

Do you sacrifice yourself to protect her? Do you tell the truth, or construct a lie? Do you bolt for the door and risk a bullet, or wait for the right moment?

TAKE ME INSTEAD KILL HER WORTHLESS ASS TELL THE TRUTH RUN FOR IT WAIT & PLAN GAME OVER
BRANCHING LOGIC

EVERY NODE.
EVERY EDGE.

The Alacrity Hub maps a living logic web of 16 scenes and 22 branching paths. Your loyalty, honesty, and survival instincts are all tracked.

THE PIPELINE

ALACRITY
HUB

No template existed for this. We built one. The Alacrity Hub is a bespoke production pipeline — a visual node-graph that manages emotional tension metrics, tracks story branches, and exports directly to Unity's VR Player.

HEADSET Meta Quest Family
CAMERA RIG Insta360 Titan + Canon R-Series
RESOLUTION 11K Video Stitching
AUDIO Ambisonic · 7.1 Binaural
POST DaVinci Resolve · 1TB+ per shoot
GAME ENGINE Unity · JSON VR Bundle
COMPLIANCE VRC.Quest.Privacy.1 Verified
DISTRIBUTION SideQuest · Meta Horizon (coming)

WHAT COMES NEXT

THE ROADMAP

01
META HORIZON STORE LAUNCH

VRC compliance verified. Privacy policy live. The next step is porting directly to the Meta Horizon Store to reach the full mainstream Quest audience.

02
AI SCRIPT IMPORTER

The Alacrity Hub's next iteration will auto-parse multipathway screenplays and generate the full node-web instantly — cutting pre-production from weeks to seconds.

03
QUANTUM LEAP PREMIUM DLC

Advanced narrative branches available as premium content. New environments, chiaroscuro lighting, and atmospheric depth far beyond the warehouse.

04
THE EXPERIENCE ARCHITECT

The long-term vision: immersive architectural spaces — digital and physical — where the line between viewer and narrative is permanently erased.
